cards.name: Drain Life
cards.oracleText:
Spend only black mana on X.
Drain Life deals X damage to any target. You gain life equal to the damage dealt, but not more life than the player's life total before the damage was dealt, the planeswalker's loyalty before the damage was dealt, or the creature's toughness.

cards.name: Mana Drain
cards.oracleText: Counter target spell. At the beginning of your next main phase, add an amount of {C} equal to that spell's mana value.

cards.name: Syphon Soul
cards.oracleText: Syphon Soul deals 2 damage to each other player. You gain life equal to the damage dealt this way.

cards.name: Psychic Drain
cards.oracleText: Target player mills X cards and you gain X life.

cards.name: Syphon Mind
cards.oracleText: Each other player discards a card. You draw a card for each card discarded this way.

cards.name: Drain Power
cards.oracleText: Target player activates a mana ability of each land they control. Then that player loses all unspent mana and you add the mana lost this way.

cards.name: Energy Tap
cards.oracleText: Tap target untapped creature you control. If you do, add an amount of {C} equal to that creature's mana value.

cards.name: Mind Drain
cards.oracleText: Target opponent discards two cards, mills a card, and loses 1 life. You gain 1 life. (To mill a card, a player puts the top card of their library into their graveyard.)

cards.name: Drain the Well
cards.oracleText: Destroy target land. You gain 2 life.

cards.name: Essence Drain
cards.oracleText: Essence Drain deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.

cards.name: Drench the Soil in Their Blood
cards.oracleText: When you set this scheme in motion, after this main phase, there is an additional combat phase followed by an additional main phase. Creatures you control gain vigilance until end of turn.

cards.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card. If you don't control a Faerie, exile a card from your hand.
